reasoning: We need exactly 1 vertex-disjoint clique of size 3, and every vertex must belong to one of these cliques. But 1 clique of size 3 covers only 3 vertices, while we have 10 vertices total. It's impossible for all 10 vertices to belong to cliques when we only have 1 clique of size 3 (covering 3 vertices). 10 is not divisible by 3 in a way that allows exactly 1 clique of size 3 to cover all vertices.
